title: The AI Behind Your Feed: Personalization, Moderation, and the Future of Social Media
description: Explores AI's role in social media, from content personalization to moderation, and its impact on user experience and privacy.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in social media, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in social media for journalists, editors, platform teams, and readers tracking information systems.
